newsitem.title: CHINA: SOCCER-CHINA NEARER GOAL OF ASIAN GIANT.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-CHINA NEARER GOAL OF ASIAN GIANT.

text.p: China moved a step closer to its goal of becoming a soccer giant in Asia with the return of the Jianlibao youth team after two years of training in Brazil.
"Chinese soccer is pinning high hopes on this team," the Beijing Youth Daily said on Wednesday.
The newspaper likened the team's 21-month training in Brazil to "a pilgrimage for Buddhist scriptures."
The team, consisting of three coaches and 24 players, aged 14 to 16 when they were sent to Brazil, returned to a hero's welcome on Tuesday.
Soccer has swept China off its feet. The world's most populous nation has a professional league, but the Asian crown has been a distant dream.
